Unit Economics Case Prompt (shared template block).
You are advising the operations committee of a mid-sized logistics firm. The case concerns a delivery network serving 12 cities from 3 depots. Depots differ in size and automation. Orders arrive in two waves, morning and evening, and the fleet is a mix of owned vans and contracted riders. Your brief contains monthly cost and volume data for the last 9 months.
Question instructions. Answer both questions. Question 1: estimate the contribution margin per delivered order for each depot and identify which cost line explains the difference between the strongest and weakest depot. Question 2: propose two operational interventions with quantified estimates of their effect on the break-even volume of the weakest depot. Support every estimate with arithmetic shown line by line, and state the assumption behind each number you cite.
Citations. Reference the operations handbook sections 4 and 7 for cost-line definitions, and the depot p&l template for the monthly data. Do not consult external market reports; the case is self-contained. Submit the analysis as a two-page memo addressed to the committee, and attach the arithmetic appendix as a separate exhibit labeled with your candidate code.
